text.zh-CN:
肺炎是肺部发生炎症，通常由感染引起，可能影响身体获得氧气。

- 肺内小气囊可出现液体或脓性分泌物，导致咳嗽、发热和气短。
- 有时呼吸或咳嗽时胸痛，伴明显疲倦和食欲下降。
- 婴幼儿、老年人或免疫低下者表现可能不典型，严重程度差异很大。
text.en:
Pneumonia is lung inflammation, usually from infection, that can affect oxygen delivery.

- Fluid or pus in small air sacs can cause cough, fever and breathlessness.
- Breathing-related chest pain, fatigue and poor appetite may occur.
- Infants, older adults and immunocompromised people may show atypical symptoms.

text.zh-CN:
病原体和个人情况共同影响风险。

- 细菌、病毒和某些真菌都可能致病，感冒或流感后也可能发生。
- 吞咽困难时食物或液体误入肺部，可引起吸入相关肺炎。
- 吸烟、慢性心肺病、免疫功能减弱及年龄因素可增加风险。
text.en:
Risk depends on both the cause and the person.

- Bacteria, viruses and some fungi can cause pneumonia, including after flu.
- Food or fluid entering the lungs can cause aspiration-related pneumonia.
- Smoking, chronic disease, reduced immunity and age affect risk.

text.zh-CN:
出现缺氧或意识变化应急救。

- 喘到不能说完整句子、呼吸明显困难，需要立即帮助。
- 嘴唇或皮肤发蓝、突然意识混乱、咳血，应紧急评估。
- 婴儿叫不醒、身体松软或明显呼吸费力，需要立即急救。
text.en:
Signs of oxygen shortage or altered consciousness need emergency help.

- Severe breathing difficulty or inability to speak normally is urgent.
- Blue lips, new confusion or coughing blood requires immediate assessment.
- An unresponsive, floppy or struggling infant needs emergency care.

text.zh-CN:
怀疑肺炎时不要只凭退烧判断。

- 咳嗽伴气短、胸痛或明显不适，应及时评估。
- 服抗生素两三天仍无改善，或任何时候明显变重，应联系医生。
- 幼儿、老人和有基础病者，更容易需要医院治疗。
text.en:
Fever improvement alone does not establish recovery.

- Cough with breathlessness, chest pain or marked illness needs assessment.
- Contact the clinician if antibiotics bring no improvement after two to three days or if worsening occurs.
- Young, older and chronically ill people may need hospital care.

text.zh-CN:
诊断需要结合症状、查体和适当检查。

- 听诊了解呼吸音，血氧检查帮助判断氧气是否充足。
- 胸片观察肺部改变，化验可评估炎症或寻找病原体。
- 不是每个人都做全部检查，影像也不能单独确定是哪种病菌。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines symptoms, examination and selected tests.

- Listening to the chest and measuring oxygen help assess severity.
- Chest imaging and laboratory tests assess lung changes and possible causes.
- Not everyone needs every test; imaging alone does not identify every germ.

text.zh-CN:
早期症状可能与其他呼吸问题重叠。

- 普通感冒或流感也会咳嗽发热，但持续气短需进一步判断。
- 哮喘或其他慢性肺病也可能引起喘鸣和呼吸困难。
- 新发胸痛、咳血或快速加重不能在家用症状表排除危险原因。
text.en:
Early symptoms overlap with other respiratory problems.

- Colds and flu can cause fever and cough, but breathlessness needs further assessment.
- Asthma and chronic lung disease can also cause wheezing.
- Chest pain, bleeding or rapid deterioration cannot be safely ruled out by symptom matching.

text.zh-CN:
治疗按病原体和严重程度决定。

- 细菌性肺炎通常需要抗生素。
- 部分病毒或真菌感染有针对性药物，不能统一套用抗生素。
- 缺氧或病情重时可能需要住院、氧疗和其他支持。
text.en:
Treatment depends on the cause and severity.

- Bacterial pneumonia usually needs antibiotics.
- Selected viral or fungal infections require different medicines.
- Low oxygen or severe illness may need hospital care and supportive treatment.

text.zh-CN:
药物各有用途和限制。

- 抗生素按处方完成，不能因稍好就停，也不借用别人的药。
- 退热止痛药改善舒适度，不能替代感染治疗。
- 不要自行用强力止咳药压住所有咳嗽；咳嗽有助排出分泌物，使用前询问适用性。
- 若使用抗生素，可能出现恶心或腹泻；呼吸困难、咽喉紧或口舌肿胀可能是严重过敏，应立即求助。
text.en:
Medicines have different purposes.

- Complete the prescribed antibiotics rather than stopping early or borrowing treatment.
- Fever and pain medicines improve comfort without replacing infection care.
- Do not automatically suppress every cough; it helps clear secretions.
- When antibiotics are used, nausea or diarrhoea may occur; breathing difficulty, throat tightness or mouth or tongue swelling may signal a serious allergy and need immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
恢复期饮食以维持摄入为主。

- 少量多次进食可以应对食欲不佳。
- 能够吞咽时维持适当饮水，避免脱水。
- 反复呛咳或吞咽困难要先评估进食安全，不能强行灌水。
text.en:
Recovery nutrition aims to maintain intake.

- Smaller, more frequent meals may help poor appetite.
- Maintain appropriate fluids when swallowing is safe.
- Repeated choking needs swallowing assessment rather than forced drinks.

text.zh-CN:
休息与观察应同时进行。

- 发热或明显不适期间休息，体力恢复后逐步活动。
- 记录呼吸、体温、饮水和用药后变化。
- 不吸烟，咳嗽时遮挡口鼻并洗手，减少传播。
text.en:
Rest and observation work together.

- Rest during fever or marked illness, then return gradually to activity.
- Track breathing, temperature, fluids and treatment response.
- Avoid smoking and use cough and hand hygiene.

text.zh-CN:
高风险人群可能没有明显高热。

- 老年人可主要表现为无力或突然意识混乱。
- 婴儿可能喂养差、烦躁或呼吸有呻吟声。
- 免疫低下、慢性心肺病或吞咽障碍患者需更早评估。
text.en:
Higher-risk groups may lack a prominent fever.

- Older adults may mainly become weak or confused.
- Infants may feed poorly or grunt while breathing.
- Reduced immunity, heart or lung disease and swallowing difficulty warrant earlier assessment.

text.zh-CN:
体力恢复常慢于退热。

- 许多人需数周恢复，部分人疲倦更久。
- 按病情复诊，持续咳嗽、气短或体重变化应说明。
- 症状好转后再恶化时，需要排查治疗失败或并发问题。
text.en:
Energy often returns later than fever settles.

- Recovery may take weeks and fatigue can last longer.
- Discuss persistent cough, breathlessness or weight changes at review.
- Deterioration after improvement warrants reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
严重肺炎可能影响全身。

- 氧气不足可导致呼吸衰竭，需要支持呼吸。
- 感染可进入血液并造成危重全身反应。
- 肺内脓肿或肺周积液等可能使恢复延长，需要进一步治疗。
text.en:
Severe pneumonia can affect the whole body.

- Low oxygen can progress to respiratory failure.
- Infection may spread to blood and cause severe systemic illness.
- Abscesses or fluid around the lung may prolong recovery and need additional treatment.

text.zh-CN:
预防包括疫苗和减少暴露。

- 按年龄、基础病和当地安排接种肺炎球菌、流感等相关疫苗。
- 洗手、咳嗽礼仪和不吸烟有助减少部分风险。
- 吞咽困难者按评估采取进食措施；疫苗不能预防所有肺炎。
text.en:
Prevention combines vaccination and risk reduction.

- Follow local age- and risk-based vaccine recommendations.
- Hand hygiene, cough etiquette and smoking avoidance reduce some risks.
- Follow swallowing advice where needed; vaccines do not prevent every pneumonia.
